existing_rows_audit.detail: The Paris office exists (https://point72.com/locations/), but there is no Quantitative Developer req of any kind posted for Paris. Paris has exactly six live reqs in the feed at https://careers.point72.com/ and only three are in-scope tracks: Cubist Execution Trader (CSS-0015045, Trader), Entry-Level Quantitative Researcher (CSS-0012600, Research) and Quantitative Researcher (CSS-0010379, Research), plus a Quantitative Portfolio Manager and two internships. The C++/Quantitative Developer row for Paris is not supported.

A real and closely matching req exists but under a different title: 'Quantitative Developer, Trading Research' (IVS-0014934), https://careers.point72.com/CSJobDetail?jobName=quantitative-developer-trading-research&jobCode=IVS-0014934&location=Warsaw,+PL. It is the firm's strongest C++ opening in scope (modern C++ plus Python, 3+ yrs). Note it sits under Point72 Technology, not Cubist, so the 'Cubist QD' framing in the existing row is wrong.

The Tokyo office does exist (https://point72.com/locations/), so this is not an invented office. But Tokyo has only 10 live reqs and none is a Quantitative Developer or any C++ role — the list is Academy programs, Fundamental Equities, HR, business development, an AV support specialist, and Cubist's Entry-Level Quantitative Researcher (CSS-0012600, Research track). The C++ Tokyo row should be dropped or re-pointed at the Research req.

London has 26 live reqs and none is titled Quantitative Developer. The nearest C++-adjacent London openings are 'Software Engineer, Macro Quant Analytics Technology' (PIT-0014783, C#-primary with only C++ 'exposure') and 'Low-Latency Market Data Engineer' (CSS-0013455, an infrastructure/RHEL role asking 10 years). Neither matches the existing row's stated requirements (modern C++ 14/17/20, 0-3 YoE). The existing row's requirement bullets do not correspond to any live Point72 posting.

Out of scope for this pass (US offices excluded by the brief), so not researched. Note that no req titled plain 'Quantitative Developer' is posted for New York either — the only one in the whole feed is Hong Kong-only (CSS-0012687).

notes:
Method: careers.point72.com is a Salesforce-hosted site that renders listings client-side, so the HTML page returns no visible job links. The full job feed (220 live reqs, all locations, with complete descriptions and a lastModified date of 2026-08-03) is embedded in the page source as the first argument to CSSearchModule.init(). I parsed that feed directly and read every in-scope posting's full text, then spot-checked constructed CSJobDetail URLs (all returned HTTP 200 with the correct job title in <title>). Every role above is verified-primary against that feed. Individual postings also carry Greenhouse apply links (boards.greenhouse.io/point72 or grnh.se), included in notes.

Offices: point72.com/locations/ confirms London, Milan, Paris and Warsaw in EMEA and Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo (plus Bengaluru, Sydney, Taipei) in APAC. There is NO Shanghai office and no Dublin/Amsterdam/Frankfurt/Swiss presence. Milan is a confirmed office but has zero live reqs in the feed, in any track.

Key correction for the sheet: the 'Cubist Quantitative Developer, C++, everywhere' premise behind all five existing rows does not hold. Exactly one req is titled Quantitative Developer (Hong Kong, CSS-0012687) and it is Python-first with no C++ mentioned. The only genuinely C++ developer opening in scope is Warsaw's Quantitative Developer, Trading Research (IVS-0014934), which sits under Point72 Technology rather than Cubist. The firm's in-scope hiring is overwhelmingly Research, not C++.

Eligibility gates: the Point72 Academy programs (CPA-* job codes, present in London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo) ARE graduation-year gated — titles read 'for Upcoming Graduates (2027 - UK/SG/HK/JP)' — and are excluded here. There are parallel 'Academy for Experienced Professionals' variants (CPA-0014730 UK, CPA-0014870 SG, CPA-0014863 HK, CPA-0014869 JP) that are not year-gated, but they are investment-analyst (fundamental equities) tracks, out of the four tracks in scope. Cubist's 'Entry-Level Quantitative Researcher' despite its title carries no graduation-year gate.

Compensation: several reqs state a USD base range. Those ranges are US pay-transparency disclosures on multi-location reqs and each posting explicitly says actual compensation varies by geographic location, so they should not be read as London/Paris/Hong Kong numbers. No local-currency figure is stated anywhere for an in-scope city; comp_local is left empty where nothing credible was seen.

Excluded deliberately: internships (CSS-0012598 QR Intern, CSS-0011537 Quantitative Software Developer Intern, CSS-0012603/CSS-0005569 Alpha Researcher Interns, CPA-* summer programs); Quantitative Portfolio Manager reqs (CSS-0000007 London/Paris/Hong Kong, CSS-0012596 Singapore) as far above this candidate's level; Warsaw's Platform Engineer (PIT-0014931) and the Warsaw data-engineering reqs as cloud/DevOps and Python-data rather than C++; and London's AI Solutions Architect (IVS-0015166) as a client-facing enablement role rather than ML engineering. No page was blocked or unreachable during this research.
